messages:
maria: Quick check — plan to roll quant-profile v1.06 + kernel 3.2.1 to a canary slice tonight at 23:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy? Window 23:00-00:30. Staggered slices, rollback readiness required. @sre-oncall FYI.

jake: I can own the deploy, happy to take slice ops.

devon: Can you drop PR links and the preflight checklist?

maria: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 (kernel) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4322 (quant). CI green but staging perf has one outstanding check.

eng-deploy-bot: CI status: kernel PR ✅, quant PR ✅ — canary images baked (image tags: quant-v1.06, kernel-3.2.1).

sana: I'll run smoke tests. Quick checklist I'll run: 1) token latency baseline vs control; 2) tail p95; 3) KV cache correctness on long sessions; 4) model fidelity spot-checks. Will post results here.

maria: Rollback plan: keep previous stable image tagged 'stable-202603' ready. Rollback criteria: error-rate spike > 3% absolute OR latency p95 > +30% vs baseline OR any fidelity regression flagged by evals. Use orchestrator rollback command if needed.

jake: Copying commands, deploy I'll run: 
```sh
rwdctl deploy --slice canary-7 --image quant-v1.06-kernel-3.2.1 --strategy staggered --max-az 1
```

sana: Smoke command I'll use: 
```sh
rwdctl smoke --slice canary-7 --checks latency,kv,throughput,fidelity --sample 200
```
I'll kick this +10m after the slice flip.

devon: I'll wire up a quick grafana dashboard and alerts (p95, error-rate). ETA ~40m.

maria: @jake also run the loadgen with the long-context preset to hit KV-heavy paths: `tools/loadgen --preset long --seed 42`.

jake: On it. I'll ping back with health or rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby for rollback. If you need an emergency traffic shift, ping #incidents and call me.

sana: Smoke run started 23:12 UTC. Initial read: latency +5% vs baseline, p95 +12%, no errors yet. Posting short logs shortly.

maria: Good. If p95 climbs above +20% we stop the ramp. Watch KV cache hitrate closely.

jake: Canary flipped at 23:15 UTC for canary-7. Loadgen started.

sana: Smoke finished 23:25 UTC. Results summary: latency +6%, p95 +13%, error-rate 0.2% (baseline 0.15%). KV cache hitrate stable. Fidelity spot-check: 10/10 acceptable. Recommend ramp to +2 slices.

maria: Approved. Ramp plan: +1 slice every 10 min until we hit 10% traffic or 00:00 UTC. Abort/rollback if error >0.5% or p95 >+25%.

devon: Dashboard and alerting wired, alerts go to #eng-runtime-alerts and paging to oncall.

jake: Ramping now to canary-8 and canary-9.

sana: Monitoring — no regressions observed in first ramp window.

maria: Final notes: please document any oddities. If rollback happens, add a short postmortem (5-10 bullet points). If all good, I'll merge canary -> stable rollout plan tomorrow morning once metrics are steady. :thumbsup:

jake: Ack, will update thread with final health and images.

sana: Will paste full smoke logs and a tiny CSV summary in 10m.
